markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early once the last winless team or tied teams can be unconditionally determined.
markets.rules_primary: If Tennessee remains winless the longest, measured by the Pro Football week of its first win, with teams that finish winless ranked last in the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
First win: This market resolves based on the team that remains winless the longest in the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, measured by the Pro Football week of its first win, rather than the exact date or time. A tied game does not count as a win.
Same-week first wins: If the last remaining winless teams record their first wins in the same NFL week, they are considered tied for this market, even if one wins on Thursday and another on Sunday of that week.
Winless season: A team that finishes the regular season without a win ranks after every team that records a win. If multiple teams finish the regular season winless, those teams are considered tied for this market.
Tie resolution: If N teams are tied for last, Yes positions on each tied team pay $1/N, rounded down to the nearest cent, and No positions pay $1 minus the Yes payout. Other teams resolve to No.

markets.rules_primary: If San Francisco is the last remaining undefeated team in the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Note: This market resolves based on the team that stays undefeated the longest, measured by the week of their first loss (not exact date/time). A tie (game result) does not count as a loss. Therefore, a team with a tie on its record is still considered undefeated if they have not lost yet.
Same-Week Losses: If the last remaining undefeated teams lose in the same week of the season, they are considered tied for the purposes of this market, even if one lost on Thursday and the other Sunday of that week.
Bye Weeks: A team on a bye-week is treated as still undefeated that week; if the other last undefeated team loses that same week, the team on a bye wins, regardless of what happens the following week.
Multiple Teams Go Undefeated: If multiple teams finish the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season undefeated, then they are considered tied for the purposes of this market.
Tie Resolution: If multiple teams are tied for the last undefeated team, “Yes” positions will pay $1/N (rounded down to the nearest cent), where N is the number of tied teams, and “No” positions will pay 1 minus the "Yes" payout.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Governing League. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.
